decisions.label: Charge speed vs her walk
decisions.note: Charges run at least this many times her walking speed, on till they catch her walking straight away: only stepping out of the lane, a blink sideways or the treetops get her clear (0: as before).

decisions.label: Winded after a missed charge (s)
decisions.note: Seconds a charger stands winded after a charge that hit nothing (dodged by a blink or a sidestep): the time to land your 💌s.

decisions.label: Leaps lead her
decisions.note: How far a leap aims ahead of her, to where she'll be when it lands (1: all the way, 0: where she was).
